summary: The Decathalon datalist loader is implemented but not verified by running anything, since the task forbade running tests or code. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new loader plus a private _resolve_path helper, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with four tests in TestLoadDecathalonDatalist. Nothing is committed. Line lengths were checked by measurement only; black and flake8 were not run. Judgment calls: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError, and malformed JSON propagates json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass). The test file changed on disk during the session; I kept the current state and only re-split three over-long calls.
